steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; let error = null; try { await rt.runExtractionNow(undefined, 'manual'); } catch (err) { error = String(err?.message ?? err); } const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); const failed = Boolean(error) || Boolean(snap.extraction?.scheduler?.lastError) || ['error', 'stalled-rechecking', 'not-configured'].includes(snap.pipeline?.state); if (!failed) throw new Error('the pass did not fail, so this is not the failed-pass case: ' + JSON.stringify({ error, pipeline: snap.pipeline, lastError: snap.extraction?.scheduler?.lastError })); return { error, pipeline: snap.pipeline?.state, lastError: snap.extraction?.scheduler?.lastError ?? null };
